title: ZWEK alloy fabrication procedure
author: Lumei Liu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.iepcbdn

steps.title: Melt Magnesium
steps.instruction: Heat high purity Mg (99.97%) in a low carbon steel crucible under an inert ultra-high purity argon environment to 710°C for 10 minutes until the slug is completely melted.

steps.title: Add Alloying Elements
steps.instruction: Incorporate each alloying element into the melt individually to ensure complete dissolution.

substeps.instruction: Hold for 10 minutes after each addition before adding the next element

steps.title: Homogenize Melt
steps.instruction: Apply automated stirring for 15 minutes to ensure a homogeneous distribution of elements throughout the melt.

steps.title: Cast Alloy
steps.instruction: Raise the melt temperature to 730°C, hold for 15 minutes, and pour into a steel tube mold.

steps.title: Perform Solution Heat Treatment
steps.instruction: Carry out a solution heat treat on the as-cast alloy at 510°C for 10 hours.

steps.title: Extrude Alloy
steps.instruction: Extrude the alloy using the specified parameters.
